claims.claim: Odyssey-3 is a 14-billion-parameter generative world model that creates interactive environments from text prompts in real time.
claims.episode_span: It’s a 14-billion-parameter generative world model that creates interactive 3D-like environments from text prompts in real time.
claims.source_title: Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free
claims.supporting_quote: The base Odyssey-3 model has 14 billion parameters and generates video at 832 × 480 pixels, according to the official benchmark submission.

claims.claim: Anthropic updated its rules so Claude can stop talking if someone is repeatedly cruel with no purpose, effective November 12.
claims.episode_span: Anthropic updated its rules so the AI can simply stop talking if someone is repeatedly cruel with no purpose. The change starts November 12
claims.source_title: Like Bullying AI? Claude Will Now Give You the Cold Shoulder If You Take It Too Far
claims.supporting_quote: The policy update is meant to apply only in extreme cases, where users repeatedly act cruelly toward our models, with no discernible purpose.
